title: Sugreeva kills Kumbha
introduction: Angada kills Kampana and severely injures Shonitaksha, the demons in battle. Angada, along with Mainda and Dvivida the monkey-warriors encounter Shonitaksha, Yupaksha and Prajangha. Angada kills Prajangha. Shonitaksha dies in the hands of Dvivida and Youpaksha at the hands of Mainda. When Kumbha throws down Angada in the battle-field, Rama sends some more monkey-chiefs headed by Jambavan. Sugreeva, with his thunderbolt-like fist, strikes Kumbha with a heavy blow and kills him.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये युद्धकांडे षट्सप्ततितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 76th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
प्रवृत्ते सङ्कुले तस्मिन्घोरे वीरजनक्षये |
अङ्गदः कम्पनं वीरमाससाद रणोत्सुकः
verses.iast:
pravṛtte sañkule tasminghore vīrajanakṣaye |
añgadaḥ kampanaṃ vīramāsasāda raṇotsukaḥ
verses.translation: While that terrific battle, which destroyed many eminent heroes, was in progress, Angada, who was eager to fight, attacked the valiant Kampana.

verses.devanagari:
आहूय सोऽङ्गदं कोपात्ताडयामास वेगितः |
गदया कम्पनः पूर्वं स चचाल भृशाहतः
verses.iast:
āhūya so'ñgadaṃ kopāttāḍayāmāsa vegitaḥ |
gadayā kampanaḥ pūrvaṃ sa cacāla bhṛśāhataḥ
verses.translation: Calling Angada to fight, Kampana with fury, rapidly struck him with a mace in anticipation. Violently hit by him, Angada was reeled.

verses.devanagari:
स संज्ञां प्राप्य तेजस्वी चिक्षेप शिखरं गिरेः |
अर्दितश्च प्रहारेण कम्पनः पतितो भुवि
verses.iast:
sa saṃGYāṃ prāpya tejasvī cikṣepa śikharaṃ gireḥ |
arditaśca prahāreṇa kampanaḥ patito bhuvi
verses.translation: Restoring consciousness, the energetic Angada hurled a mountain peak. Tormented by that stroke, Kampana fell down on the ground.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु कम्पनं दृष्ट्वा शोणिताक्षो हतं रणे |
रथेनाभ्यपतत् क्षिप्रं तत्राङ्गदमभीतवत्
verses.iast:
tatastu kampanaṃ dṛṣṭvā śoṇitākṣo hataṃ raṇe |
rathenābhyapatat kṣipraṃ tatrāṇ^gadamabhītavat
verses.translation: Then, seeing Kampana killed in battle, Shonitaksha fearlessly rushed there towards Angada quickly in a chariot.

verses.devanagari:
सोऽङ्गदं निशितैर्बाणैस्तदा विव्याध वेगितः |
शरीरदारणैस्तीक्षणैः कालाग्निसमविग्रहैः
क्षुरक्षुरप्रनाराचैर्वत्सदनैः शिलीमुखैः |
कर्णिशल्यविपाठैश्च बहुभिर्निशितैः शरैः
verses.iast:
so'ṇ^gadaṃ niśitairbāṇaistadā vivyādha vegitaḥ |
śarīradāraṇaistīkṣaṇaiḥ kālāgnisamavigrahaiḥ
kṣurakṣurapranārācairvatsadanaiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ |
karṇiśalyavipāṭhaiśca bahubhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
verses.translation: He then swiftly struck Angada with sharp pointed arrows which can tear up the limbs and with fire-like forms which can destroy the world. He struck with many sharp arrows by the names of Kshura, Kshurapra, Naaraacha, Vatsatanta, Shilimukha, Karni, Shalya and Vipatha.

glosses.meaning: which can tear up the body
with fire-like forms which can destroy the world
Kshura (an arrow with a crescent-shaped head)
Naracha (an arrow entirely made of steel)
Shilimukha (an arrow with its head shaped like the feathers of a buzzard)
Karni (an arrow provided with ear-like protuberances on both sides
Vipatha (an arrow with its head resembling the leaf of a Karaveera tree.

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गदः प्रतिविद्धाङ्गो वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् |
धनुरुग्रं रथं बाणान् ममर्द तरसा बली
verses.iast:
aṇ^gadaḥ pratividdhāṇ^go vāliputraḥ pratāpavān |
dhanurugraṃ rathaṃ bāṇān mamarda tarasā balī
verses.translation: The strong and powerful Angada, the son of Vali, with his wounded limbs, crushed his terrific bow, chariot and darts with his might.

verses.devanagari:
शोणिताक्षस्ततः क्षिप्रमसिचर्म समाददे |
उत्पपात तदा क्रुद्धो वेगवानविचारयन्
verses.iast:
śoṇitākṣastataḥ kṣipramasicarma samādade |
utpapāta tadā kruddho vegavānavicārayan
verses.translation: Then, Shonitaksha quickly took a sword and a shield. Enraged as he was, he swiftly jumped down (from his chariot) unhesitatingly.

verses.devanagari:
तं क्षिप्रतरमाप्लुत्य परामृश्याङ्गदो बली |
करेण तस्य तं खड्गं समाच्चिद्य ननाद च
verses.iast:
taṃ kṣiprataramāplutya parāmṛśyāṇ^gado balī |
kareṇa tasya taṃ khaḍgaṃ samāccidya nanāda ca
verses.translation: Springing forward more swiftly, seizing hold of him with his hand and snatching away the sword, the strong Angada made a lion's roar.

verses.devanagari:
तस्यांसफलके खड्गं निचखान ततोऽङ्गदः |
यज्ञोपवीतवच्चैनं चिच्चेद कपिकुञ्जरः
verses.iast:
tasyāṃsaphalake khaḍgaṃ nicakhāna tato'ṇ^gadaḥ |
yajJṇopavītavaccainaṃ cicceda kapikuJṇjaraḥ
verses.translation: Angada the foremost of monkeys the sword into the flat surface of his shoulder and cut him from left to right diagonally.

glosses.meaning: into the flat surface of his shoulder

verses.devanagari:
तं प्रगृह्य महाखड्गं विनद्य च पुनः पुनः |
वालिपुत्रोऽभिदुद्राव रणशीर्षं परानरीन्
verses.iast:
taṃ pragṛhya mahākhaḍgaṃ vinadya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
vāliputro'bhidudrāva raṇaśīrṣaṃ parānarīn
verses.translation: Taking hold of that large sword and repeatedly roaring, Angada rushed towards the other surviving enemies in the battle-front.

verses.devanagari:
प्रजङ्घसहितो वीरो यूपाक्षस्तु ततो बली |
रथेनाभिययौ क्रुद्धो वालिपुत्रं महाबलम्
verses.iast:
prajaṇ^ghasahito vīro yūpākṣastu tato balī |
rathenābhiyayau kruddho vāliputraṃ mahābalam
verses.translation: Taking hold of that large sword and repeatedly roaring, Angada rushed towards the other surviving enemies in the battle-front.

verses.devanagari:
आयसीम् तु गदाम् गृह्य स वीरः कनकाङ्गदः |
शोणिताक्षः समाश्वस्य तमेवानुपपात ह
verses.iast:
āyasīm tu gadām gṛhya sa vīraḥ kanakāṇ^gadaḥ |
śoṇitākṣaḥ samāśvasya tamevānupapāta ha
verses.translation: That valiant Shonitaksha, wearing golden armlets, restoring his consciousness, took an iron mace and rushed quickly towards the same Angada.

verses.devanagari:
प्रजङ्घस्तु महावीरो यूपाक्षसहितो बली |
गदयाभिययौ क्रुद्धो वालिपुत्रं महाबलम्
verses.iast:
prajaṇ^ghastu mahāvīro yūpākṣasahito balī |
gadayābhiyayau kruddho vāliputraṃ mahābalam
verses.translation: The strong and the great warrior, Prajangha on his part, along with Yupaksha, was enraged and rushed towards the mighty Angada with his mace.

verses.devanagari:
तयोर्मध्ये कपिश्रेष्ठः शोणिताक्षप्रजङ्घयोः |
विशाखयोर्मध्यगतः पूर्णचन्द्र इवाबभौ
verses.iast:
tayormadhye kapiśreṣṭhaḥ śoṇitākṣaprajaṇ^ghayoḥ |
viśākhayormadhyagataḥ pūrṇacandra ivābabhau
verses.translation: Angada, the chief of monkeys, between the two warriors, Shonitaksha and Prajangha, shone like a full moon between the two asterisms known as Vishakhas.

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गदं परिरक्षनौ मैन्दो द्विविद एव च |
तस्य तस्थतुरभ्याशे परस्परदिदृक्षया
verses.iast:
aṇ^gadaṃ parirakṣanau maindo dvivida eva ca |
tasya tasthaturabhyāśe parasparadidṛkṣayā
verses.translation: Protecting Angada, Mainda and Dvivida took their position near Angada, with an intent to exhibit each of their own martial skill.

glosses.meaning: with an intent to exhibit each his own martial skill.

verses.devanagari:
अभिपेतुर्महाकायाः प्रतियत्ता महाबलाः |
राक्षसा वानरान् रोषादसिबाणगदाधराः
verses.iast:
abhipeturmahākāyāḥ pratiyattā mahābalāḥ |
rākṣasā vānarān roṣādasibāṇagadādharāḥ
verses.translation: The mighty demons with their colossal bodies retaliated and rushed in anger, wielding swords, arrows and maces, towards the monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
त्रयाणां वानरेन्द्राणाम् त्रिभिराक्षसपुम्गवैः |
संसक्तानाम् महद्युद्धमभवद्रोमहर्षणम्
verses.iast:
trayāṇāṃ vānarendrāṇām tribhirākṣasapumgavaiḥ |
saṃsaktānām mahadyuddhamabhavadromaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: A great battle, causing hair to stand on end, was waged by the three monkey-chiefs who encountered the three excellent demons.

glosses.meaning: causing hair to stand on end

verses.devanagari:
ते तु वृक्षान् समादाय सम्प्रचिक्षिपुराहवे |
खड्गेन प्रतिचिक्षेप तान् प्रजङ्ग महाबलः
verses.iast:
te tu vṛkṣān samādāya sampracikṣipurāhave |
khaḍgena praticikṣepa tān prajaṇ^ga mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: In the battle-field, the monkeys, seizing hold of trees, hurled them against the demon-chiefs. The mighty Prajangha, however, cut them down with his sword.

verses.devanagari:
रथानश्वान् द्रुमान् शैलान् प्रतिचिक्षिपुराहवे |
शरौघैः प्रतिचिच्छेद तान्यूपाक्षो महाबलः
verses.iast:
rathānaśvān drumān śailān praticikṣipurāhave |
śaraughaiḥ praticiccheda tānyūpākṣo mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The monkeys in the battle-field hurled trees and rocks towards chariots and horses. The mighty Yupaksha chopped them off with a flood of arrows.

verses.devanagari:
सृष्टान् द्विवदमैन्दाभ्यां द्रुमानुत्पाट्य वीर्य्वान् |
बभञ्ज गदया मद्य शोणिताक्षः प्रतापवान्
verses.iast:
sṛṣṭān dvivadamaindābhyāṃ drumānutpāṭya vīryvān |
babhaJṇja gadayā madya śoṇitākṣaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: Shonitaksha, the valiant and the powerful demon, chopped off the trees uplifted and hurled by Dvivida and Mainda with his mace in the midway itself.

verses.devanagari:
उद्यम्य विपुलं खड्गं परमर्मविदारणम् |
प्रजङ्घो वालिपुत्राय अभिदुद्राव वेगितः
verses.iast:
udyamya vipulaṃ khaḍgaṃ paramarmavidāraṇam |
prajaṇ^gho vāliputrāya abhidudrāva vegitaḥ
verses.translation: Prajangha, lifting a large sword, which can chop off vital parts of the enemies, rushed swiftly towards Angada.

glosses.meaning: which can chop off vital parts of the enemies

verses.devanagari:
तमभ्याशगतं दृष्ट्वा वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः |
आजघानाश्वकर्णेन द्रुमेणातिबलस्तदा
verses.iast:
tamabhyāśagataṃ dṛṣṭvā vānarendro mahābalaḥ |
ājaghānāśvakarṇena drumeṇātibalastadā
verses.translation: Then the mighty Angada, who was exceedingly strong, seeing him coming nearer, struck him with an Ashvakarna tree.

verses.devanagari:
बाहुं चास्य सनिस्त्रिंशमाजघान स मुष्टिना |
वालिपुत्रस्य घातेन स पपात क्षितावसिः
verses.iast:
bāhuṃ cāsya sanistriṃśamājaghāna sa muṣṭinā |
vāliputrasya ghātena sa papāta kṣitāvasiḥ
verses.translation: Angada struck, with his fist, the arm of Prajangha, holding the sword. By that blow, the sword fell on the ground.

verses.devanagari:
तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ खड्गम् मुसलसंनिभम् |
मुष्टिं संवर्तयामास वज्रकल्पं महाबलः
verses.iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau khaḍgam musalasaṃnibham |
muṣṭiṃ saṃvartayāmāsa vajrakalpaṃ mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that sword looking like a pebble (in shape), which fell on the ground, the mighty Prajangha tightened his thunderbolt like fist.

glosses.meaning: looking like a pebble in shape)

verses.devanagari:
स ललाटे महावीर्यमङ्गदं वानरर्षभम् |
आजघान महातेजाः स मुहूर्तं च्चाल ह
verses.iast:
sa lalāṭe mahāvīryamaṇ^gadaṃ vānararṣabham |
ājaghāna mahātejāḥ sa muhūrtaṃ ccāla ha
verses.translation: When that Prajangha of great splendour struck Angaa, the excellent monkey with a great strength on his forehead, Angada shuddered for a moment.

verses.devanagari:
स संज्ञाम् प्राप्य तेजस्वी वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् |
प्रजङ्घस्य शिरः कायात्पातयामास मुष्टिना
verses.iast:
sa sañjJṇām prāpya tejasvī vāliputraḥ pratāpavān |
prajaṇ^ghasya śiraḥ kāyātpātayāmāsa muṣṭinā
verses.translation: That Angada of splendour and prowess, restoring his consciousness, struck with his fist and shattered Prajangha's head off his trunk.

verses.devanagari:
स यूपाक्षोऽश्रुपूर्णाक्षः पितृव्ये निहते रणे |
अवरुह्य रथान् क्षिप्रं क्षीणेषुः खड्गमाददे
verses.iast:
sa yūpākṣo'śrupūrṇākṣaḥ pitṛvye nihate raṇe |
avaruhya rathān kṣipraṃ kṣīṇeṣuḥ khaḍgamādade
verses.translation: That Yupaksha, with tears filled in his eyes because of the death of his paternal uncle in battle, quickly took a sword as his arrows were exhausted and descended from his chariot.

glosses.meaning: with tears filled in his eyes
because of the death of his paternal uncle
and since his arrows were exhausted

verses.devanagari:
तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य यूपाक्षं द्विविदस्त्वरन् |
आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो जग्राह च बलाद्बली
verses.iast:
tamāpatantaṃ samprekṣya yūpākṣaṃ dvividastvaran |
ājaghānorasi kruddho jagrāha ca balādbalī
verses.translation: Seeing that Yupaksha rushing on him, Dvivida hurriedly struck Yupaksha on his chest and with a rage, forcibly caught hold of him.

glosses.meaning: with rage balii = the strong Dvivida

verses.devanagari:
गृहीतं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा शोणिताक्षो महाबलम् |
आजघान महातेजा वक्षसि द्विविदं ततः
verses.iast:
gṛhītaṃ bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā śoṇitākṣo mahābalam |
ājaghāna mahātejā vakṣasi dvividaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: Seeing his mighty brother being seized, Shonitaksha, of great splendour, then struck Dvivida on his chest.

verses.devanagari:
स ततोऽभिहतस्तेन चचाल च महाबलः |
उद्यतां च पुनस्तस्य जहार द्विविदो गदाम्
verses.iast:
sa tato'bhihatastena cacāla ca mahābalaḥ |
udyatāṃ ca punastasya jahāra dvivido gadām
verses.translation: That mighty Dvivida, struck by Shonitaksha was tottered; but pulled off the platter's mace when lifted again on him.

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे मैन्दो द्विविदाभ्याशमागमत् |
यूपाक्षं ताडमामास तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
etasminnantare maindo dvividābhyāśamāgamat |
yūpākṣaṃ tāḍamāmāsa talenorasi vīryavān
verses.translation: Meanwhile, Mainda came nearer to Dvivida and banged Yupaksha on his chest with his palm.

verses.devanagari:
तौ शोणिताक्षयूपाक्षौ प्लवम्गाभ्यां तरस्विनौ |
चक्रतुः समरे तीव्रमाकर्षोत्पाटनं भृशम्
verses.iast:
tau śoṇitākṣayūpākṣau plavamgābhyāṃ tarasvinau |
cakratuḥ samare tīvramākarṣotpāṭanaṃ bhṛśam
verses.translation: Those two demons, Shonitaksha and Yupaksha, who were full of violence, carried on a keen contest with the two monkeys in the battle field, by pulling and overthrowing them vehemently and severely.

verses.devanagari:
द्विविदः शोणिताक्षं तु विददार नखैर्मुखे |
निष्पिपेष च वीर्येण क्षितावाविध्य वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
dvividaḥ śoṇitākṣaṃ tu vidadāra nakhairmukhe |
niṣpipeṣa ca vīryeṇa kṣitāvāvidhya vīryavān
verses.translation: The valiant Dvivida, after splitting open shonitaksha's face with his claws, threw him down on the floor by his strength and crushed him down.

verses.devanagari:
यूपाक्षमभिसंक्रुद्धो मैन्दो वानरपुंगवः |
पीडयामास बाहुभ्यां पपात स हतः क्षितौ
verses.iast:
yūpākṣamabhisaṅkruddho maindo vānarapuṅgavaḥ |
pīḍayāmāsa bāhubhyāṃ papāta sa hataḥ kṣitau
verses.translation: Mainda, the foremost of monkeys, was enraged and pressed Yupaksha with his arms. Yupaksha fell down dead on the ground.

verses.devanagari:
हतप्रप्रवीरा व्यथिता राक्षसेन्द्रचमूस्तदा |
जगामाभिमुखी सा तु कुम्भकर्णात्मजो यतः
verses.iast:
hataprapravīrā vyathitā rākṣasendracamūstadā |
jagāmābhimukhī sā tu kumbhakarṇātmajo yataḥ
verses.translation: That army of demons, which was perturbed with their great warriors killed, then moved with its face turned towards the place where Kumbha (the son of Kumbhakarna) was carrying on battle.

verses.devanagari:
आपतन्तीम् च वेगेन कुम्भस्तां सान्त्वयच्चमूम् |
अथोत्कृष्टं महावीर्यैर्लब्धलक्षैः प्लवम्गमैः
निपातितमहावीरां दृष्ट्वा रक्षश्चमूं तदा |
कुम्भः प्रचक्रे तेजस्वी रणे कर्म सुदुष्करम्
verses.iast:
āpatantīm ca vegena kumbhastāṃ sāntvayaccamūm |
athotkṛṣṭaṃ mahāvīryairlabdhalakṣaiḥ plavamgamaiḥ
nipātitamahāvīrāṃ dṛṣṭvā rakṣaścamūṃ tadā |
kumbhaḥ pracakre tejasvī raṇe karma suduṣkaram
verses.translation: Kumbha, restored to confidence, that army which was coming towards him with speed. Then, seeing the army of demons whose chief-warriors were thrown down by the most powerful monkeys who could fulfill their aim, the powerful Kumbha then performed a great feat which was very difficult to do in a battle.

glosses.meaning: restored to confidence taam chamuum = that army
having their chief warriors plavaN^gamaiH = by the most powerful monkeys
which was very difficult to do

verses.devanagari:
स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य सुसमाहितः |
मुमोचाशीविषप्रख्याञ्शरान्देहविदारणान्
verses.iast:
sa dhanurdhanvināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pragṛhya susamāhitaḥ |
mumocāśīviṣaprakhyāñśarāndehavidāraṇān
verses.translation: That Kumbha, the foremost among the wielders of bow, taking his bow and fully composed, released serpentine arrows which can split open the bodies.

glosses.meaning: the foremost among the wielders of bow
which can split open the bodies.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तच्छुशुभे भूयः सशरं धनुरुत्तमम् |
विद्युदैरावतार्चिष्मद्द्वितीयेन्द्रधनुर्यथा
verses.iast:
tasya tacchuśubhe bhūyaḥ saśaraṃ dhanuruttamam |
vidyudairāvatārciṣmaddvitīyendradhanuryathā
verses.translation: That excellent bow of his, fitted with an arrow, shone like a second bow of Indra (the rain-god), illumined by flashes of lightning and the splendour of Airavata (the elephant carrying Indra on its back).

glosses.meaning: like a second bow of indra (the rain-god)
illumined by flashes of lightning and the splendour of Airavata (the elephant carrying Indra on its back).

verses.devanagari:
आकर्णकृष्टमुक्तेन जघान द्विविदं तदा |
तेन हाटकपुङ्खेन पत्रिणा पत्रवाससा
verses.iast:
ākarṇakṛṣṭamuktena jaghāna dvividaṃ tadā |
tena hāṭakapuñkhena patriṇā patravāsasā
verses.translation: By that arrow with a golden shaft and fastened with feathers, drawn upto his ear and discharged, he then struck Dvivida.

glosses.meaning: drawn upto the ear and discharged

verses.devanagari:
सहसाभिहतस्तेन विप्रमुक्तपदः स्फुरन् |
निपपाताद्रिकूटाभो विह्वलः प्लवगोत्तमः
verses.iast:
sahasābhihatastena vipramuktapadaḥ sphuran |
nipapātādrikūṭābho vihvalaḥ plavagottamaḥ
verses.translation: Suddenly struck by that arrow, that excellent monkey possessing a splendour of Mount Trikuta, was perturbed, with his feet swaying to and fro and fell down throbbing.

glosses.meaning: having a splendour of Mount Trikuta
with his feet swaying to and fro

verses.devanagari:
मैन्दस्तु भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा भग्नं तत्र महाहवे |
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन प्रगृह्य महतीं शिलाम्
verses.iast:
maindastu bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagnaṃ tatra mahāhave |
abhidudrāva vegena pragṛhya mahatīṃ śilām
verses.translation: Beholding his brother defeated in that great battle, Mainda there on his part, taking a large rock, rushed with speed to attack the demon.

verses.devanagari:
तां शिलां तु प्रचिक्षेप राक्षसाय महाबलः |
बिभेद तां शिलां कुम्भः प्रसन्नैः पञ्चभिः शरैः
verses.iast:
tāṃ śilāṃ tu pracikṣepa rākṣasāya mahābalaḥ |
bibheda tāṃ śilāṃ kumbhaḥ prasannaiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ
verses.translation: While that mighty Mainda hurled that rock towards the demon, Kumbha broke that rock into pieces with his five shining arrows.

verses.devanagari:
सन्धाय चान्यं सुमुखं शरमाशीविषोपमम् |
आजघान महातेजा वक्षसि द्विविदाग्रजम्
verses.iast:
sandhāya cānyaṃ sumukhaṃ śaramāśīviṣopamam |
ājaghāna mahātejā vakṣasi dvividāgrajam
verses.translation: Stretching another arrow resembling a serpent and with a good pointed tip, Kumbha of a great splendour, struck it on the chest of Mainda the brother of Dvivida.

glosses.meaning: mahaatejaaH = Kumbha possessing a great splendour
of Mainda the brother of Dvivida.

verses.devanagari:
स तु तेन प्रहारेण मैन्दो वानरयूथपः |
मर्मण्यभिहतस्तेन पपात भुवि मूर्छितः
verses.iast:
sa tu tena prahāreṇa maindo vānarayūthapaḥ |
marmaṇyabhihatastena papāta bhuvi mūrchitaḥ
verses.translation: As that blow of Kumbha's arrow struck that Mainda, the monkey-chief, on his vital parts, he fell unconscious on the ground.

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गदो मातुलौ दृष्ट्वा पतितौ तौ महाबलौ |
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कुम्भमुद्यतकार्मुकम्
verses.iast:
añgado mātulau dṛṣṭvā patitau tau mahābalau |
abhidudrāva vegena kumbhamudyatakārmukam
verses.translation: Seeing both his mighty maternal uncles wounded, Angada rushed speedily towards Kumbha, who was standing with his bow uplifted.

verses.devanagari:
तमापतन्तं विव्याध कुम्भः पञ्चभिरायसैः |
त्रिभिश्चान्यैः शितैर्बाणैर्मातङ्गमिव तोमरैः
verses.iast:
tamāpatantaṃ vivyādha kumbhaḥ pañcabhirāyasaiḥ |
tribhiścānyaiḥ śitairbāṇairmātañgamiva tomaraiḥ
verses.translation: With five steel arrows and with three other sharp-edged arrows, Kumbha pierced that Angada advancing towards him, as on would pierce an elephant with goads.

glosses.meaning: and with three other sharp arrows
who was coming near to him
as (one would fierce) an elephant tomaraiH = with goads.

verses.devanagari:
सोऽङ्गदं विविधैर्बाणैः कुम्भो विव्याध वीर्यवान् |
अकुण्ठधारैर्निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैः कनकभूषणैः
verses.iast:
so'ñgadaṃ vividhairbāṇaiḥ kumbho vivyādha vīryavān |
akuṇṭhadhārairniśitaistīkṣṇaiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: That valiant Kumbha pierced Angada with a multiple of sharp arrows, decked in gold, with edges which were harsh and sharp.

glosses.meaning: with edges which were not blunt

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गदः प्रतिविद्धाङ्गो वालिपुत्रो न कम्पते |
शिलापादपवर्षाणि तस्य मूर्ध्नि ववर्ष ह
verses.iast:
añgadaḥ pratividdhāñgo vāliputro na kampate |
śilāpādapavarṣāṇi tasya mūrdhni vavarṣa ha
verses.translation: Angada, the son of wind-god, though pierced all over the body with sharp arrows, was however not shaken. He showered a rain of rocks and trees on Kumbha's head.

glosses.meaning: though pierced all over the body with sharp arrows
a rain of rocks and trees

verses.devanagari:
स प्रचिच्छेद तान्सर्वान्बिभेद च पुनः शिलाः |
कुम्भकर्णात्मजः श्रीमान्वालिपुत्रसमीरितान्
verses.iast:
sa praciccheda tānsarvānbibheda ca punaḥ śilāḥ |
kumbhakarṇātmajaḥ śrīmānvāliputrasamīritān
verses.translation: The glorious Kumbha the son of Kumbhakarna chopped off all those trees hurled by Angada and burst off the rocks further.

verses.devanagari:
आपतन्तं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य कुम्भो वानरयूथपम् |
भ्रुवोर्विव्याध बाणाभ्यामुल्काभ्यामिव कुञ्जरम्
verses.iast:
āpatantaṃ ca samprekṣya kumbho vānarayūthapam |
bhruvorvivyādha bāṇābhyāmulkābhyāmiva kuñjaram
verses.translation: Seeing Angada the monkey-chief rushing upon him, Kumbha pierced his brows with his brows with his arrows, as an elephant would be struck with flaming torches.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य सुस्राव रुधिरं पिहिते चास्य लोचने |
अङ्गदः पाणिना नेत्रे पिधाय रुधिरोक्षिते
सालमासन्नमेकेन परिजग्राह पाणिना |
verses.iast:
tasya susrāva rudhiraṃ pihite cāsya locane |
añgadaḥ pāṇinā netre pidhāya rudhirokṣite
sālamāsannamekena parijagrāha pāṇinā |
verses.translation: Since Angada's blood was oozing out, his eyes were covered with blood; Covering his eyes, dampened with blood, with one hand, he caught hold of a Sala tree nearby with another hand.

verses.devanagari:
सम्पीड्योरसि सस्कन्धम् करेणाभिनिवेश्य च
किञ्चिदभ्यवनम्यैनमुन्ममाथ महारणे |
verses.iast:
sampīḍyorasi saskandham kareṇābhiniveśya ca
kiJṇcidabhyavanamyainamunmamātha mahāraṇe |
verses.translation: In the battle-field, propping that tree with branches and all, on his chest, holding it with his hand and bending a little, Angada uprooted it from the ground.

glosses.meaning: that tree with branches and all

verses.devanagari:
तमिन्द्रकेतुप्रतिमं वृक्षं मन्दरसंनिभम्
समुत्सृजन्तं वेगेन पश्यतां सर्वरक्षसाम् |
verses.iast:
tamindraketupratimaṃ vṛkṣaṃ mandarasaṃnibham
samutsṛjantaṃ vegena paśyatāṃ sarvarakṣasām |
verses.translation: While all the demons were looking on, Angada hurled that tree-which was tall like Indra's banner and resembled Mount Mandara in size.

verses.devanagari:
स चिच्छेद शितैर्बाणैः सप्तभिः कायभेदनैः
अङ्गदो विव्यथेऽभीक्ष्णं ससाद च मुमोह च |
verses.iast:
sa ciccheda śitairbāṇaiḥ saptabhiḥ kāyabhedanaiḥ
añgado vivyathe'bhīkṣṇaṃ sasāda ca mumoha ca |
verses.translation: That Kumbha chopped off that tree with seven sharp arrows which were capable of splitting asunder the body. That Angada was very much perturbed and fell down, swooning.

glosses.meaning: which were capable of splitting asunder the body

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गदं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा सीदन्तमिव सागरे
दुरासदं हरिश्रेष्ठा राघवाय न्यवेदयन् |
verses.iast:
añgadaṃ vyathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sīdantamiva sāgare
durāsadaṃ hariśreṣṭhā rāghavāya nyavedayan |
verses.translation: Seeing the unconquerable Angada fallen down and sinking into depression as though in an ocean, the monkey-chiefs informed the matter to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
रामस्तु व्यथितं श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रं महाहवे
व्यादिदेश हरिश्रेष्ठाञ्जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्ततः |
verses.iast:
rāmastu vyathitaṃ śrutvā vāliputraṃ mahāhave
vyādideśa hariśreṣṭhāñjāmbavatpramukhāṃstataḥ |
verses.translation: Hearing of Angada being seized with anguish in that great combat, Rama sent out for help, leaders of monkeys, headed by Jambavan.

glosses.meaning: for help the leaders of monkeys

verses.devanagari:
ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः श्रुत्वा रामस्य शासनम्
अभिपेतुः सुसङ्क्रुद्धाः कुम्भमुद्यतकार्मुकम् |
verses.iast:
te tu vānaraśārdūlāḥ śrutvā rāmasya śāsanam
abhipetuḥ susañkruddhāḥ kumbhamudyatakārmukam |
verses.translation: Hearing Rama's message, those excellent monkeys were very much enraged and quickly rushed towards Kumbha who was wielding a bow in his hand.

glosses.meaning: who was holding up a bow.

verses.devanagari:
ततो द्रुमशिलाहस्ताः कोपसंरक्तलोचनाः
रिरक्षिषन्तोऽभ्यपतन्नङ्गदं वानरर्षभाः |
verses.iast:
tato drumaśilāhastāḥ kopasaṃraktalocanāḥ
rirakṣiṣanto'bhyapatannañgadaṃ vānararṣabhāḥ |
verses.translation: With an intent to defend Angada, the monkey-chiefs then holding trees and rocks in their hands and with their furious blood-red eyes, rushed on.

glosses.meaning: wielding trees and rocks in their hands
and with their eyes reddened of fury

verses.devanagari:
जाम्बवांश्च सुषेणश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः
कुम्भकर्णात्मजं वीरं क्रुद्धाः समभिदुद्रुवुः |
verses.iast:
jāmbavāṃśca suṣeṇaśca vegadarśī ca vānaraḥ
kumbhakarṇātmajaṃ vīraṃ kruddhāḥ samabhidudruvuḥ |
verses.translation: The enraged Jambavan, Sushena and Vegadarshi, the monkey ran up towards Kumbha the son of Kumbhakarna to attack him.

glosses.meaning: towards Kumbha the son of Kumbhakarna.

verses.devanagari:
समीक्ष्यातततस्तांस्तु वानरेन्द्रान्महाबलान्
आववार शरौघेण नगेनेव जलाशयम् |
verses.iast:
samīkṣyātatatastāṃstu vānarendrānmahābalān
āvavāra śaraugheṇa nageneva jalāśayam |
verses.translation: Seeing those mighty monkey-chiefs coming nearer to him, Kumbha covered them with a flood of arrows, as one would obstruct the course of a stream by means of a rock.

glosses.meaning: covered (them) sharaugheNa = with a flood of arrows
as one would obstruct the course of a stream by means of a rock.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य बाणचयं प्राप्य न शोकेरतिवर्तितुम्
वानरेन्द्रा महात्मानो वेलामिव महोदधिः |
verses.iast:
tasya bāṇacayaṃ prāpya na śokerativartitum
vānarendrā mahātmāno velāmiva mahodadhiḥ |
verses.translation: Reaching the range of his arrows, the great souled monkey-chiefs were unable even to look at him, much less advance towards him, any more than a great ocean would overstep its shore.

glosses.meaning: any more than a great ocean (would overstep)

verses.devanagari:
तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा हरिगणाञ्शरवृष्टिभिरर्दितान्
अङ्गदं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा भ्रातृजं प्लवगेश्वरः |
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन सुग्रीवः कुम्भमाहवे
शैलसानु चरं नागं वेगवानिव केसरी |
verses.iast:
tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā harigaṇāñśaravṛṣṭibhirarditān
añgadaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā bhrātṛjaṃ plavageśvaraḥ |
abhidudrāva vegena sugrīvaḥ kumbhamāhave
śailasānu caraṃ nāgaṃ vegavāniva kesarī |
verses.translation: Seeing those troops of monkeys being tormented by a flood of arrows, Sugreeva the king of monkeys, keeping Angada his brother's son in the rear, rushed headlong towards Kumbha in the battle, as a swift lion would bounce upon an elephant walking along the slopes of a mountain.

glosses.meaning: towards Kumbha the son of Kumbhakarna
walking along with slopes of a mountain.

verses.devanagari:
उत्पाट्य च महाशैलानश्वकर्णान्धवान्बहून्
अन्यांश्च विविधान्वृक्षांश्चिक्षेप च महाकपिः |
verses.iast:
utpāṭya ca mahāśailānaśvakarṇāndhavānbahūn
anyāṃśca vividhānvṛkṣāṃścikṣepa ca mahākapiḥ |
verses.translation: Uprooting many large trees beginning with Ashvakarna and many kinds of trees, Sugreeva the king of monkeys hurled them on Kumbha.

verses.devanagari:
तां छादयन्तीमाकाशं वृक्षवृष्टिं दुरासदाम्
कुम्भकर्णात्मजः श्रीमांश्चिच्छेद निशितैः शरैः |
verses.iast:
tāṃ chādayantīmākāśaṃ vṛkṣavṛṣṭiṃ durāsadām
kumbhakarṇātmajaḥ śrīmāṃściccheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
verses.translation: The illustrious Kumbha, the son of Kumbhakarna, with his sharp arrows, chopped off that down pour of trees, which was obscuring the sky and which was difficult to be assailed.

glosses.meaning: and which was difficult to be attacked.

verses.devanagari:
अभिलक्ष्येण तीव्रेण कुम्भेन निशितैः शरैः
निर्भिद्यमानास्ते रेजुर्यथा घोरशतघ्नयः |
verses.iast:
abhilakṣyeṇa tīvreṇa kumbhena niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
nirbhidyamānāste rejuryathā ghoraśataghnayaḥ |
verses.translation: The trees, chopped off with his sharp arrows by the brutal Kumbha, skilled in hitting his target, shone like terrific Shataghnis (stones or cylindrical pieces of wood studded with iron spikes).

glosses.meaning: who was skilled in hitting his target
like terrific Shataghnis (stones or cylindrical pieces of wood studded with iron spikes).

verses.devanagari:
द्रुमवर्षं तु तच्छिन्नं दृष्ट्वा कुम्भेन वीर्यवान्
वानराधिपतिः श्रीमान्महासत्त्वो न विव्यथे |
verses.iast:
drumavarṣaṃ tu tacchinnaṃ dṛṣṭvā kumbhena vīryavān
vānarādhipatiḥ śrīmānmahāsattvo na vivyathe |
verses.translation: Seeing that shower of trees chopped off by Kumbha, the mighty and illustrious Sugreeva of valour was not disturbed.

verses.devanagari:
स विध्यमानः सहसा सहमानश्च ताञ्शरान्
कुम्भस्य धनुराक्षिप्य बभञ्जेन्द्रधनुःप्रभम् |
verses.iast:
sa vidhyamānaḥ sahasā sahamānaśca tāñśarān
kumbhasya dhanurākṣipya babhañjendradhanuḥprabham |
verses.translation: Enduring those arrows being hit, Sugreeva snatched away Kumbha's bow, possessing the splendour of a rain-bow and broke it all at once.

glosses.meaning: having the splendour of a rain-bow

verses.devanagari:
अवप्लुत्य ततः शीघ्रं कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्
अब्रवीत्कुपितः कुम्भं भग्नशृङ्गमिव द्विपम् |
verses.iast:
avaplutya tataḥ śīghraṃ kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram
abravītkupitaḥ kumbhaṃ bhagnaśṛñgamiva dvipam |
verses.translation: Thus bouncing swiftly and doing that most difficult task, the enraged Sugreeva spoke (as follows) to Kumbha, who was looking like an elephant with a broken tusk.

glosses.meaning: who was looking like an elephant

verses.devanagari:
निकुम्भाग्रज वीर्यं ते बाणवेगं तदद्भुतम्
संनतिश्च प्रभावश्च तव वा रावणस्य वा |
verses.iast:
nikumbhāgraja vīryaṃ te bāṇavegaṃ tadadbhutam
saṃnatiśca prabhāvaśca tava vā rāvaṇasya vā |
verses.translation: "O Kumbha, the elder brother of Nikumbha! Both your prowess and the swiftness of your arrow are wonderful. Both Ravana and you are equal in complaisance towards demons and the majesty too exists.

verses.devanagari:
प्रह्रादबलिवृत्रघ्नकुबेरवरुणोपम
एकस्त्वमनुजातोऽसि पितरं बलवत्तरः |
verses.iast:
prahrādabalivṛtraghnakuberavaruṇopama
ekastvamanujāto'si pitaraṃ balavattaraḥ |
verses.translation: "O Kumbha, the compeer of Prahlada, Bali, Indra (the destroyer of the demon Vritra), Kubera (the god of riches) and Varuna (the god of water)! You alone are born with a likeness of your father (Kumbhakarna) who was exceedingly strong."

verses.devanagari:
त्वामेवैकं महाबाहुं शूलहस्तमरिन्दमम्
त्रिदशा नातिवर्तन्ते जितेन्द्रियमिवाधयः |
विक्रमस्व महाबुद्धे कर्माणि मम पश्य च
verses.iast:
tvāmevaikaṃ mahābāhuṃ śūlahastamarindamam
tridaśā nātivartante jitendriyamivādhayaḥ |
vikramasva mahābuddhe karmāṇi mama paśya ca
verses.translation: "The celestials cannot surpass even you alone, with a spike in hand, who can destroy the enemy with your large arms, as mental agonies cannot overwhelm the one who subdued his senses. Hence, exhibit your prowess, O demon of great intellect and see my exploits."

glosses.meaning: as mental agonies cannot overwhelm his senses

verses.devanagari:
वरदानात्पितृव्यस्ते सहते देवदानवान् |
कुम्भकर्णस्तु वीर्येण सहते च सुरासुरान्
verses.iast:
varadānātpitṛvyaste sahate devadānavān |
kumbhakarṇastu vIryeṇa sahate ca surāsurān
verses.translation: "Because of the boon received by him, Ravana your uncle is able to attack the celestials and demons. But Kumbhakarna (your father) on his part is tolerating the celestials and demons."

glosses.meaning: due to receipt of a boon

verses.devanagari:
धनुषीन्द्रजितस्तुल्यः प्रतापे रावणस्य च |
त्वमद्य रक्षसां लोके श्रेष्ठोऽसि बलवीर्यतः
verses.iast:
dhanuṣīndrajitastulyaḥ pratāpe rāvaṇasya ca |
tvamadya rakṣasāṃ loke śreṣṭho'si balavīryataḥ
verses.translation: "You are equal in archery to Indrajit and in prowess to Ravana. Hence, you are now the foremost in strength and heroism among the demon-folk."

verses.devanagari:
महाविमर्दं समरे मया सह तवाद्भुतम् |
अद्य भूतानि पश्यन्तु शक्रशम्बरयोरिव
verses.iast:
mahāvimardaṃ samare mayā saha tavādbhutam |
adya bhūtāni paśyantu śakraśambarayoriva
verses.translation: "Let the created beings see your great wonderful fight with me in the battle field today, as they saw that fight between Indra and Shambara, the demon."

glosses.meaning: like the fight occurred between Indra and Shambara

verses.devanagari:
कृतमप्रतिमं कर्म दर्शितं चास्त्रकौशलम् |
पातिता हरिवीराश्च त्वयैते भीमविक्रमाः
verses.iast:
kṛtamapratimaṃ karma darśitaṃ cāstrakauśalam |
pātitā harivīrāśca tvayaite bhīmavikramāḥ
verses.translation: "You have performed an incomparable task. You have also shown your skill in missile weaponry. You have struck down these monkey-heroes possessing a terrific prowess."

verses.devanagari:
उपालम्भभयाच्चापि नासि वीर मया हतः |
कृतकर्मा परिश्रान्तो विश्रान्तः पश्य मे बलम्
verses.iast:
upālambhabhayāccāpi nāsi vīra mayā hataḥ |
kṛtakarmā pariśrānto viśrāntaḥ paśya me balam
verses.translation: "O valiant demon! Since you look tired after performing your martial duty, I did not kill you, with a fear of public censure. Identify my strength, after taking some rest."

verses.devanagari:
तेन सुग्रीववाक्येन सावमानेन मानितः |
अग्नेराज्यहुतस्येव तेजस्तस्याभ्यवर्धत
verses.iast:
tena sugrīvavākyena sāvamānena mānitaḥ |
agnerājyahutasyeva tejastasyābhyavardhata
verses.translation: Kumbha was thus honoured with those insulting words of Sugreeva. Kumbha's splendour then enhanced, like the splendour of the sacrificial fire, when a melted butter is offered to it as an oblation."

glosses.meaning: with those insulting words of Sugreeva
like a splendour of the sacrificial (enhances)
when a melted butter is offered as an oblation.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कुम्भस्तु सुग्रीवं बाहुभ्यां जगृहे तदा |
गजाविवातमदौ निःश्वसन्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः
अन्योन्यगात्रग्रथितौ घर्षन्तावितरेतरम् |
सधूमां मुखतो ज्वालां विसृजन्तौ परिश्रमात्
verses.iast:
tataḥ kumbhastu sugrīvaṃ bāhubhyāṃ jagṛhe tadā |
gajāvivātamadau niḥśvasantau muhurmuhuḥ
anyonyagātragrathitau gharṣantāvitaretaram |
sadhūmāṃ mukhato jvālāṃ visṛjantau pariśramāt
verses.translation: The reopen, Kumbha pressingly clasped Sugreeva in his arms. Then, they stood breathing heavily again and again as elephants in rut, having their bodies fastened against each other, rubbing one another and emitting a flame to blaze with smoke from their faces because of their fatigue.

glosses.meaning: like elephants whose rut was not worn out
having their bodies wound each other

verses.devanagari:
तयोः पादाभिघाताच्च निमग्ना चाभवन्मही |
व्याघूर्णिततरङ्गश्च चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः
verses.iast:
tayoḥ pādābhighātācca nimagnā cābhavanmahī |
vyāghūrṇitataraṇ^gaśca cukṣubhe varuṇālayaḥ
verses.translation: The battle-ground sank under the trampling of their feet. With their waves whirled about, the ocean became turbulent.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कुम्भं समुत्क्षिप्य सुग्रीवो लवणाम्ब्भसि |
पातयामास वेगेन दर्शयन्नुदधेस्तलम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ kumbhaṃ samutkṣipya sugrīvo lavaṇāmbbhasi |
pātayāmāsa vegena darśayannudadhestalam
verses.translation: Then tossing up Kumbha, Sugreeva threw him down speedily into the ocean, showing him the bottom of the sea.

glosses.meaning: him the bottom of the sea.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कुम्भनिपातेन जलराशिः समुत्थितः |
विन्ध्यमन्दरसंकाशो विससर्प समन्ततः
verses.iast:
tataḥ kumbhanipātena jalarāśiḥ samutthitaḥ |
vindhyamandarasaṅkāśo visasarpa samantataḥ
verses.translation: Due to the hurling down of Kumbha, the fully risen sea, reaching a height of as to that of Mount Vindhya, diffused on all sides.

glosses.meaning: due to throwing down of Kumbha
equal to the height of Mount Vindhya

verses.devanagari:
तस्य चर्म च पुस्फोट सञ्जज्ञे चास्य शोणितम् |
स च मुष्टिर्महावेगः प्रतिजघ्नेऽस्थिमण्डले
verses.iast:
tasya carma ca pusphoṭa sañjaGYe cāsya śoṇitam |
sa ca muṣṭirmahāvegaḥ pratijaghne'sthimaṇḍale
verses.translation: The enraged Kumbha, then jumping up and throwing down Sugreeva, struck him on his chest with his thunderbolt-like fist.

glosses.meaning: on his chest muShTinaa = with his fist

verses.devanagari:
तदा वेगेन तत्रासीत्तेजः प्रज्वालितं मुहुः |
वज्रनिष्पेषसञ्जातज्वाला मेरौ यथा गिरौ
verses.iast:
tadā vegena tatrāsīttejaḥ prajvālitaṃ muhuḥ |
vajraniṣpeṣasañjātajvālā merau yathā girau
verses.translation: Sugreeva's armour was burst asunder. Even blood appeared oozing out of his chest. His cage of bones gave a counter-strike to that awfully forceful fist.

verses.devanagari:
स तत्राभिहतस्तेन सुग्रीवो वानरर्षभः |
मुष्टिं संवर्तयामास वज्रकल्पं महाबलः
verses.iast:
sa tatrābhihatastena sugrīvo vānararṣabhaḥ |
muṣṭiṃ saṃvartayāmāsa vajrakalpaṃ mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Then, by the force of that fist shot forth there, a mighty flame resembling the fire that bursts up on Mount Meru, was born out of a stroke of lightning.

glosses.meaning: born out of a stroke of lighting.

verses.devanagari:
अर्चिःसहस्रविकचं रविमण्डलसप्रभम् |
स मुष्टिं पातयामास कुम्भस्योरसि वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
arciḥsahasravikacaṃ ravimaṇḍalasaprabham |
sa muṣṭiṃ pātayāmāsa kumbhasyorasi vīryavān
verses.translation: Thus struck by Kumbha there, that mighty Sugreeva, the chief of monkeys, tightened his fist which appeared like a thunderbolt.

verses.devanagari:
स तु तेन प्रहरेण विह्वलो भृशपीडितः |
निपपात तदा कुम्भो गतार्चिरिव पावकः
verses.iast:
sa tu tena prahareṇa vihvalo bhṛśapīḍitaḥ |
nipapāta tadā kumbho gatārciriva pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: The valiant Sugreeva forcefully descended his fist, which shone like the solar disc encircled by a thousand rays, on the breast of Kumbha.

glosses.meaning: which shone like the solar disc encircled by a thousand rays

verses.devanagari:
मुष्टिनाभिहतस्तेन निपपाताशु राक्षसः |
लोहिताङ्ग इवाकाशाद्दीप्तरश्मिर्यदृच्छया
verses.iast:
muṣṭinābhihatastena nipapātāśu rākṣasaḥ |
lohitāñga ivākāśāddīptaraśmiryadṛcchayā
verses.translation: That Kumbha, very much hurt by that blow, was exhausted and then fell down, like fire whose flame has extinguished.

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भस्य पततो रूपं भग्नस्योरसि मुष्टिना |
बभौ रुद्राभिपन्नस्य यथारूपं गवां पतेः
verses.iast:
kumbhasya patato rūpaṃ bhagnasyorasi muṣṭinā |
babhau rudrābhipannasya yathārūpaṃ gavāṃ pateḥ
verses.translation: Thus struck with Sugreeva's fist, that demon fell down suddenly, as the planet Mars, of splendid rays, would drop down from the sky accidentally.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन्हते भीमपराक्रमेण |
प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण युद्धे |
मही सशैला सवना चचाल |
भयं च रक्षांस्यधिकं विवेश
verses.iast:
tasminhate bhīmaparākrameṇa |
plavañgamānāmṛṣabheṇa yuddhe |
mahī saśailā savanā cacāla |
bhayaṃ ca rakṣāṃsyadhikaṃ viveśa
verses.translation: When Kumbha was killed in battle by Sugreeva the chief of monkeys, possessing a terrific prowess, the earth with its mountains and forests trembled. Too much fear seized the demons.

glosses.meaning: trembled sa shailaa = with its mountains
